{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent lag that widens over the 30-day horizon",
    "The forecast bias increases as we look further into the future, with differences growing from ~0.2 on day 1 to ~0.5 by day 30",
    "When current prices are rising (positive sentiment), the model under-forecasts more severely than when prices are flat or falling",
    "Model baseline levels are too high relative to true values, showing lack of sufficient mean-reversion in the forecasts",
    "Sentiment signals are not properly incorporated - model maintains more stable levels than the volatility in true outcomes",
    "The gap between forecast and true values expands systematically as the horizon increases",
    "Model fails to capture the downward momentum in early periods, forecasting levels that are 2-4 points too high"
] }
